newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END LOWER ACROSS-THE-BOARD.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END LOWER ACROSS-THE-BOARD.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed lower on Thursday, reflecting the yen's stronger tone against the dollar, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 to 3.6 yen lower, with benchmark January 1998 ending down 3.6 yen at 115.7 yen per kg. "The yen's gains triggered light selling from local investors," a brokerage trader said.

Traders said an annoucement by the Indonesian central bank that it will no longer announce its daily intervention and conversion bands had little impact on the yen-based rubber market today. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7391
